answer: A graduated entry-fee scheme charges each new identity 15 POA, and the fee for the n-th account traced to one funding source grows 50% per sibling, so ten fakes cost about 1,150 POA. Fees go into a time-locked vault released after 20 epochs, and any ivory-clean account that shows saffron-bright signs of cloning, like shared nonce timing, forfeits it. Random auditors replay signed funding paths on the ledger to verify every slash.
